If any export fails a check, it moves to Lark's queue with the others. I won't use Scout's partial workings for net retention, because there's no export to verify them against.

**3. Direct Lark to recompute the two open metrics from source.** Lark has read access and an empty queue, so it can take both. It works from source data, not from Scout's notes, and I'll review its output before anything goes in the pack.

**4. Update Noor.** She needs to know the status and the risk now, not Friday morning.

> **Subject: Q3 board pack: net retention and support tickets per customer**
>
> Lark, please take these two metrics for Noor Haddad's Q3 board pack. Scout crashed mid-run, so nothing from its unfinished work should be reused. Work from source data and read-only access. Don't edit or save anything to the customer dashboard.
>

>
> **1. Net retention (Q3)**
> - Cohort: customers active at 30 June.
> - Formula: (Cohort MRR at 30 Sep, including expansion, minus contraction and churn) ÷ Cohort MRR at 30 June.
> - Exclude customers acquired during Q3.
> - Use the churn definition in the header of Scout's saved churn export, so churn ties out. If that export has no definition, use the standard above and flag it.
> - Check that the churn component reconciles to Scout's churn figure. If it doesn't, report the difference and stop. Don't force a match.
>
> **2. Support tickets per customer (Q3)**
> - Numerator: all support tickets created 1 July to 30 September, from the helpdesk/CRM.
> - Denominator: customers active at 30 September. State this choice explicitly in the output.
> - Report the numerator and denominator separately as well as the ratio.
>
> **Deliverable (to me by Friday 09:30):**
> A single table with, for each metric:
> - Result
> - Numerator and denominator
> - Exact date range used
> - Source(s) and query or export link
> - Row counts
> - Any exclusions and why
> - Any definition choices you made
>
> Include a short note on anything you couldn't verify.
>

> - **Risk:** if source data turns out to be incomplete, I'll tell you by end of Thursday, with the options. I won't put an unverified number in the pack without flagging it.
